paras: The ADRO Carbon Fibre Vented Hood for the BMW G87 M2 blends aggressive styling with functional performance enhancements. Designed for weight reduction, improved cooling, and aerodynamic efficiency, this hood features strategically placed vents to optimise airflow and reduce engine bay temperatures. Unlike other aftermarket hoods, the ADRO design retains the signature M power bulge, preserving the heritage look that M cars are known for while adding a modern, motorsport-inspired touch.
Additionally, this hood is optimised for the ADRO M2 Facelift Front Bumper while remaining fully compatible with the OEM factory front bumper, ensuring seamless fitment regardless of your setup.
